---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something that makes the bot better at playing music. Not something that makes it a different bot.
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

Before you write this, check the scope: Krayz is a music bot. It plays audio in Discord voice channels. If your feature request is about economy systems, leveling, reaction roles, moderation beyond what exists, or anything else that is not directly related to audio playback, it does not belong here and the issue will be closed.

**What problem does this solve**

Describe the problem in concrete terms. What are you trying to do that you currently cannot? "It would be cool if..." is not a problem statement.

**Proposed solution**

Describe the behavior you want. Be specific about the user-facing interaction. What command would you run? What would the bot reply with? What happens in edge cases (the queue is empty, the user is not in a voice channel, two people trigger it at the same time)?

**Alternatives you considered**

Did you think of other ways to solve this? What made you pick the approach above? If you did not think of alternatives, say so. That is fine. But if you did and rejected them, I want to know why.

**Who benefits**

Is this something every server would use, or is it specific to certain setups? A feature that helps 200-guild deployments is different from one that helps a single server with three users.

**Implementation notes (optional)**

If you have looked at the codebase and have an idea of where the change would go (which files, which functions, how it interacts with the middleware/router/cache layers), include that. It is not required, but it saves me time and makes it more likely I will actually build it.
